title: Texas Instruments second-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Total cash was USD 7.00 billion, inventory was USD 4.61 billion, and days of inventory declined to 196 from 222 at year-end.
summary: The Form 10-Q confirms TXN common stock on Nasdaq, USD 7.001 billion of cash and short-term investments, USD 14.052 billion of current and long-term debt, USD 4.605 billion inventory and 196 inventory days. TI expects USD 2-3 billion of 2026 capital expenditures. It has agreed to acquire Silicon Labs for approximately USD 7.5 billion, funded with cash and debt, and has an undrawn USD 5 billion delayed-draw facility. The filing explains the structural-cost benefit and fixed-cost risk of internal 300mm manufacturing.
